purpose: Exploratory visual-direction boards. The deterministic HTML/CSS prototypes and exported full boards are the detailed UI comparison deliverable.
shared_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: a high-fidelity Vietnamese Student web-app design direction board, landscape 3840x2160 composition. Reference images are the ACTUAL current MathVisionKid dashboard, used only for brand, star mascot, approved utility icon set and functional scope; make a NEW concept, never label it as current. Create a beautiful professional product-design presentation board for MathVisionKid, all text Vietnamese where visible. At top, small label 'PHƯƠNG ÁN' and prominent exact concept name. Use a large desktop dashboard mockup and smaller tablet and phone dashboard across the upper half, and a tidy row/grid of secondary interface screens below. Show coherent screens representing the ENTIRE Student experience, with small clear captions: 'Đăng nhập', 'Trang chủ', 'Bài học', 'Thành tích', 'Của em', 'Chụp bài', 'Che thông tin', 'Cắt ảnh', 'Kiểm tra đề', 'Học từng bước', 'Hỏi bài', 'Nghe giảng', 'Hình phân số', 'Nhận xét bài làm', 'Bài giải', 'Thử lại'. Secondary screens may be miniature but must look like real detailed product UI rather than generic empty cards. One main action per learning screen, keep voice/fractions as optional modal tools. Only TWO voice options, no long settings list. A wrong handwritten work review shows a small translucent YELLOW highlight directly over a questionable calculation in the photo, then one short helpful comment. Preserve real math: 1/3+2/5=11/15; remainder 4/15; total 16:(4/15)=60. Never invent an error in these correct calculations. Example highlight should instead be an incorrect final total of 64, corrected toward 60. Desktop/tablet use vertical collapsible navigation; mobile uses bottom navigation. Make real responsive adaptations, not stretched phones. No technical debug text, developer info, email addresses, browser URLs, watermarks or photoreal device photography. This is a full product art-direction overview; use clean readable headings and breathing room, rich curated UI detail, avoid excessive empty space.

variants.name: TÍM TINH GỌN
variants.visual_direction: Refined lavender and warm white, deep ink violet typography, elegant pill navigation, approved purple sculpted educational illustrations, restrained shadows, sophisticated friendly Vietnamese children's education product. Desktop: compact collapsible left navigation, a bounded richly composed central dashboard with dominant camera hero and quiet continue-learning panel; learning screen a single centered focus card. Lavender #6B46F2, ink #211944, warm white #FAF9FD. Crisp modern typography.

variants.name: VỞ HỌC ẤM ÁP
variants.visual_direction: A beautifully art-directed warm paper learning studio: ivory paper #FAF5EA, forest teal #216859, muted terracotta #CD7958, ink #233B36. Editorial typography, subtle notebook line details confined to learning illustrations, bookmarks and tab shapes. Sculpted purple utilities remain recognizable but surfaces warm. Desktop: narrow vertical bookmark navigation and an asymmetric notebook dashboard with a prominent camera action and next lesson; learning single notebook page. No rustic clutter, professional premium educational website.

variants.name: KHÔNG GIAN HỌC XANH
variants.visual_direction: An exceptionally polished contemporary learning workspace, cloud white #F6FAFF, cobalt #315BD5, navy #152D53, pale sky blue and mint highlights. Crisp linework, clean 18px-rounded cards, compact expandable vertical icon rail on laptop, balanced two-column home workspace, optional source drawer closed by default in lessons, one task at a time. Strong grids and purposeful use of laptop width, designed for children 8-11. Retain friendly golden star mascot and selected purple utility illustrations as accents.

variants.name: HÀNH TRÌNH SAO NHỎ
variants.visual_direction: A premium playful star-learning journey: midnight-purple #332365 vertical desktop navigation, clean white/light lavender canvas, amber #F6BD4F and periwinkle #9383EF accents. Rich carefully crafted small 3D golden star mascot and purple stone learning trail. Home has a gently curved short lesson journey plus one dominant camera card, not a video game map. Badge collection and practice cards visually delightful. Lessons reduce to quiet white focus card with tiny step progress trail, no competing decoration or extra CTA. Strong coherent spatial design.

usage_note: Generated images are style exploration only. Product feature labels, authentication, mathematics and final layouts are defined by the actual captured UI and the authored prototypes, not by small raster text in the exploratory images. No generated exploration asset is installed in the product.
